author: Yffe
content:
PLAN + BLOCKER (honest STOP per O-5 + manifest lowerer-limitation clause).

PLAN as designed:
- (a) recursive spec fn bytes_eq(a,b,ai,bi,n)->bool, dec n, byte_at reads — VERIFIED to lower + certify L3 in isolation (probe: bytes_eq L3, 11 obligations discharged).
- (b) insert_str unchanged-prefix/inserted-run/shifted-suffix bytes_eq pins.
- (c) backspace prefix/shifted-suffix bytes_eq pins.
- (d) render_frame payload bytes_eq pin at the post-clear offset.

BLOCKER (lowerer limitation, NOT patchable within this manifest):
emit_string_wrapper (thermite-lower/src/lower.rs) emits slice() and concat() with LENGTH-ONLY ensures:
  concat: ens result.data.len() == self.data.len() + b.data.len()   (NO byte-content)
  slice : ens result.data.len() == hi - lo                          (NO byte-content)
No byte-content postcondition (no result.data@ == self.data@.subrange(lo,hi) for slice; no result.data@ == self.data@ + b.data@ for concat). insert_str/backspace/render_frame ALL build their result solely via slice+concat, so verus knows the result LENGTH but not its BYTES — any bytes_eq claim over a sliced/concatenated result is UNPROVABLE at L3.

PROOF (minimal counterexample claim):
  fn slice_id(a:&String)->String req a.len()<=900_000 ens result.len()==a.len() ens bytes_eq(&result,a,0,0,a.len()) { a.slice(0,a.len()) }
  -> bytes_eq L3, slice_id L0 (postcondition not satisfied). Even a FULL-LENGTH slice's bytes cannot be proven equal to the source.

FIX (out of scope): strengthen slice/concat ensures with the subrange/append byte-content relation (the wrapper already computes subrange invariants internally — trim's ens exposes result.data@ == self.data@.subrange(lo,hi)). That edit lives in thermite-lower/src/lower.rs::emit_string_wrapper, EXPLICITLY out of this manifest's scope.

Per O-5: NOT weakening pins to vacuity, NOT patching the toolchain. STOP + report. Prerequisite: a thermite-lower builder issue adding byte-content (subrange/append) ensures to TString::slice/concat must land FIRST. No edits to editor.th/editor_runs.rs this dispatch (baseline already kills F-IDENT via length pins: insert_str 4/4, backspace 6/6, render_frame 2/2, all L3 — verified live).
